claim_scope: Building-state/intervention-grain annual plus peak physical effect
annual_method: Current Hungarian monthly net space-heating balance using explicit physical-state inputs
peak_method: Independent design heat load from explicit design H and design delta-T
applicability_contract: building type + construction period + explicit before/after state + same climate/service + source-bound physical inputs
double_count_contract: P63 broad physical change keys may be claimed once only across sequential surface interventions; overlapping keys require one combined state transition
notes: No generic percentage. TABULA validates type/state dependence but is not household or national prevalence evidence. P62 remains bounded real-building calibration.
